title: Boring SaaS ideas for 29 September 2026
dek: Revenue notes on 10 products for 29 September 2026. All 10 are labeled Stripe-verified. Each figure links to its source.

companies.name: MyCater
companies.description: B2B catering marketplace for French companies — breakfast, lunch, events, cocktails — with ordering, invoicing, and curated caterers in one place.
companies.evidence: ~$76.0k last 30 days, ~$2.43M all-time, MRR $0 (transaction model), ~1,000 users claimed, team 2–5, bootstrapped, founded Nov 2020. Last sync Sep 29, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Vertical B2B marketplace where the buyer (EA/office manager) is not the caterer — you own the workflow, not the kitchen.

companies.name: Stan
companies.description: Creator storefront / “make a living online” platform (stan.store) — link-in-bio commerce for digital products and services.
companies.evidence: ~$3.57M MRR, ~101.6k active subscriptions, ~$2.84M L30, ~$76.6M all-time. Stripe API key expired; data last updated Apr 20, 2026 — treat as last verified snapshot, not live.
companies.indieAngle: Proof that a simple creator checkout layer can out-earn almost every “AI wrapper” on the leaderboard.

companies.name: Windmill Growth
companies.description: Done-for-you personal branding / LinkedIn content service for B2B founders (~$3,999/mo retainers).
companies.evidence: ~$111.7k MRR, 79 active subscriptions, ~$113k L30, ~$2.17M all-time, bootstrapped, founded May 2024. Last sync Sep 29, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Service-as-SaaS billing at ~$4k/seat — fewer customers, real cash, if you can deliver LinkedIn output consistently.

companies.name: PROSP
companies.description: LinkedIn outreach automation with AI personalization (prosp.ai); listed for sale on TrustMRR.
companies.evidence: ~$128.0k MRR, 1,108 active subscriptions, ~$98.5k L30, ~$507k all-time. Stripe key expired; data last updated Feb 5, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Outbound tooling still prints; the moat is account warm-up / proxy ops, not the LLM copy.

companies.name: DataExpert / TechCreator
companies.description: Data engineering + AI upskilling education (courses / community) at dataexpert.io — ~$119/mo.
companies.evidence: ~$56.0k MRR, 877 active subscriptions, ~$51.5k L30, ~$4.72M all-time, founded Mar 2023. Last sync Sep 29, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Niche technical education with free cloud sandbox access — content → paid cohort, not another chat UI.

companies.name: ControlResell
companies.description: Ops OS for pro resellers (Vinted, Shopify, etc.) — listings, negotiation, relisting, sales/purchase tracking. France-first.
companies.evidence: ~$21.5k MRR, 442 active subscriptions, ~$24.1k L30, ~$140k all-time, founded Jan 2025. Last sync Sep 29, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Pick one marketplace vertical (resale, repair, trades) and own the daily workflow — YouTube + podcast as acquisition.

companies.name: MyFrank
companies.description: B2B SaaS that gamifies Google review collection per employee (QR codes, challenges, multi-location tracking). For sale per founder note.
companies.evidence: ~$10.6k MRR, 180 active subscriptions, ~$5.7k L30, ~$68.6k all-time, founded Jun 2025. Last sync Sep 29, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Solo-plausible local-SEO wedge — sell to franchise/multi-location ops, not to consumers.

companies.name: Image-Charts
companies.description: Chart-as-image API for emails, PDFs, and chatbots (Google Image Charts spiritual successor). Bootstrapped since 2017.
companies.evidence: ~$6.3k MRR, 50 active subscriptions, ~$2.4k L30, ~$541k all-time, founded Jan 2017. Last sync Sep 29, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Longevity proof — a narrow API can compound for a decade without chasing AI hype.

companies.name: GESWORK
companies.description: Modular management software for French service companies (ops / productivity suite).
companies.evidence: ~$3.7k MRR, 41 active subscriptions, ~$4.0k L30, ~$113k all-time, founded Feb 2024. Last sync Sep 29, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Most solo-plausible ops suite of the day — country-specific service software still underserved.

companies.name: Mon Atelier
companies.description: All-in-one ERP for French repair shops (phone, PC, appliance, bike): tickets, NF525 invoices, stock, POS, booking, QualiRépar, police ledger. From €19/mo. Solo founder, 48 shops.
companies.evidence: ~$2.3k MRR, 56 active subscriptions, ~$2.8k L30, ~$15.2k all-time, founded Mar 2026, team of 1, bootstrapped. Last sync Sep 29, 2026. Founder claims 48 shops, zero marketing spend, franchise onboarding soon (company-stated on TrustMRR profile).
companies.indieAngle: Closest Conductor cousin today — pick a regulated vertical, bake compliance in, charge €19–39/mo forever.

honorableMentions.name: Avenue
honorableMentions.note: ~$85k AUD/mo (~$50k+ USD), self-reported via Stork, Sep 2026
